summary: Iteration 3 retest of the 2 fixes from iteration_2. Both fixes verified: (1) TokensScreen.copyToken now has a .catch fallback — rapid triple-click of copy-token-btn in headless chromium produced NO webpack error overlay and the 'Copied' indicator did appear. (2) Backend TOTP otpauth_uri now URL-encodes issuer/label — default request produces 'ChaosKey%2B' (no literal '+'), and issuer='My App+ 2026' produces 'My%20App%2B%202026'. Full backend regression is green: 25/25 pytest cases (12 chaoskey + 13 tokens) pass, including one new test asserting the encoded-issuer behaviour. Frontend regression: all 5 bottom-nav tabs still switch correctly, Harvest system-entropy button works (ledger grew from ~124 -> 132), Ledger renders, Universe run completes, Device tab shows Ed25519 PEM + QR + pubkey. No new issues found.

minor.issue: Pre-existing (iteration_2): `length` param is treated as INPUT byte count, so passing 43 yields a ~58-char base64url token. Not touched in iteration 3 — still ambiguous but functional.

critical_code_review_comments: urllib.parse.quote(..., safe='') correctly percent-encodes '+', ':', '@', space — good, matches RFC 6238 KeyURI spec.

TOTP label is now encoded, so ':' inside a user-supplied label will be encoded to %3A; the fixed literal ':' between issuer_enc and label_enc in the path preserves correct parsing by authenticators — correct behaviour.
Copy fallback uses document.execCommand('copy') which is deprecated but still widely supported; acceptable as a last-resort in restricted contexts.
server.py is still ~690 lines — pre-existing recommendation to split token helpers into a tokens.py module stands, but non-blocking.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_tokens.py (added test_totp_issuer_url_encoded_with_spaces_and_plus and updated test_totp_base32_and_uri to assert %2B encoding)

success_rate.frontend: 100% — no runtime errors, no overlay, all tabs and flows functional

seed_data_creation: Test run appended ~15 signed ledger blocks (blocks reached #132 by end of frontend regression).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both iteration_2 fixes are confirmed. Backend suite has 25 tests across test_chaoskey.py + test_tokens.py. Frontend has 5-tab nav (harvest/tokens/ledger/universe/device). No known regressions.
rca of the issue: N/A — this iteration verified fixes, not new bugs.
